evaluation_execution.exact_stage2_reformulation: Occupation u is continuous on [0,1] with x[i,b] <= u[b] for every eligible assignment and u[b] <= sum_i x[i,b]. Since x is binary, u is exactly the occupied-block indicator at every integer solution. This is mathematically equivalent to the original binary-u big-M formulation but has a stronger LP relaxation.
